entries.name: OmniRoute
entries.acceptance_test: Pin an exact release and run at least three synthetic/sanitized frozen tasks through a self-hosted instance with an explicit NEXUS provider allowlist; require zero policy/security/cross-project regressions, actual-provider traceability, tested rollback and measured improvement in correction burden, duration or cost.
entries.rollback: Remove OmniRoute adapter/config and route directly through the existing NEXUS Resource Router / Provider Economy path.
entries.notes: Keep as gateway adapter only. Upstream provider/model/free-tier counts are claims and change over time. Upstream ToS flags are advisory, not global routing gates. Built-in guardrails are documented fail-open. Never treat provider fallback or free availability as business/compliance authority.
